targets.root_selector: if .error then error("Monitoring query failed") elif .nextPageToken then error("Hosting response truncated") else [.timeSeries[]?.points[]?]|sort_by(.interval.endTime)|last as $p | (try ($p.interval.endTime|sub("[.][0-9]+Z$";"Z")|fromdateiso8601) catch null) as $t | {time:($p.interval.endTime//(now|todateiso8601)),value:(if $t==null or now-$t>360 or $t>now+120 then 4 elif ($p.value.int64Value|tonumber)==1 then 1 elif ($p.value.int64Value|tonumber)==0 then 0 else 4 end)} end

panels.title: Hosting · ${env}

panels.description: Reader and command: Debian collector GET /health on the ${env} reader and command services (no credentials, 10 s). Chat data · live and · reports: the authenticated native-API probes the Partner conversation depends on, always PROD: the collector signs in to the PROD command service's conversation API, checks the catalogue manifest version and makes one key-only read, of live loan and payment data (metric label oltp) or of analytics and reports data (olap). Grey after 6 minutes without a report.

targets.root_selector:
# State timeline row: every sample in the range as a state code (0 Down, 1 OK,
# 2 Degraded, 3 Paused, 4 Unknown). Booleans map true 1, false 0. Samples of one
# collector run share a timestamp; the worst member wins (0, 4, 2, 3, then 1) and
# a run missing any of the 1 members is Unknown. A gap longer than
# the freshness bound ends in null at (sample + bound), so no state stretches across
# missing telemetry; a newest sample older than the bound also ends in null at
# (sample + bound), with a second null at now so Unknown reaches the right edge.
# Provider errors and truncation fail visibly.
def stamp: sub("[.][0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601;
def code: if type == "boolean" then (if . then 1 else 0 end)
  else (try tonumber catch null) | if . != null and IN(0, 1, 2, 3, 4) then . else 4 end end;
def worst: if any(.[]; . == 0) then 0 elif any(.[]; . == 4) then 4 elif any(.[]; . == 2) then 2
  elif any(.[]; . == 3) then 3 else 1 end;
if .error then error("Monitoring query failed")
elif .nextPageToken then error("Monitoring response truncated; shorten the time range")
else
  [.timeSeries[]? | .points[]? |
    {t: (try (.interval.endTime | stamp) catch null),
     v: (.value | if has("boolValue") then .boolValue else (.int64Value // .doubleValue) end)}] |
  map(select(.t != null and .t <= now + 120)) |
  group_by(.t) | map({t: .[0].t, n: length, v: ([.[].v | code] | worst)}) as $runs |
  [range(0; $runs | length) as $i | $runs[$i] as $r |
    {time: ($r.t | todateiso8601), value: (if $r.n == 1 then $r.v else 4 end)},
    (if $i + 1 < ($runs | length) and $runs[$i + 1].t - $r.t > 360
     then {time: ($r.t + 360 | todateiso8601), value: null} else empty end)] +
  (if ($runs | length) == 0 then [{time: (now | floor | todateiso8601), value: null}]
   elif now - ($runs | last | .t) > 360
   then [{time: ($runs | last | .t + 360 | todateiso8601), value: null}, {time: (now | floor | todateiso8601), value: null}]
   else [] end) |
  .[]
end

panels.title: jobs · instances, CPU, RAM

panels.description: Log-based mw_scheduler_attempts_${env} per 5 minutes for the jobs notifications (Notify, every minute), daily-charges (Charges, 00:05) and recent-analytics (Analytics, hourly): green only successful attempts, red any failed attempt (status not OK or HTTP not 2xx). Each attempt's state holds until the job's next expected run (every minute: 2 min, hourly: 65 min, daily: 25 h); before the first attempt and after that the row is empty, with no label. DEV jobs are paused.

targets.root_selector:
# Left edge of a state-timeline row. The row query starts before the panel range (the hidden
# lookback_from variable) and the row's own selector turns it into {time, value} events as usual.
# Here every event before the range start (epoch s) is dropped except the last one at or before it,
# which moves to exactly the range start: the state carried in from before the range. A carried
# state older than the row's freshness bound at the range start becomes null (Unknown), never a stretched old
# state; with nothing before the start the row also begins with null. No event lies before the
# range start or after now, so every row starts exactly at the range start.
def clip($from; $stale):
  . as $e |
  ([$e[] | select(.t <= $from)] | last) as $c |
  (if $c == null or ($c.value != null and $from - $c.t > $stale) then {t: $from, value: null}
   else {t: $from, value: $c.value} end),
  ($e[] | select(.t > $from) | .t |= ([., (now | floor)] | min));
((${__from} / 1000 | ceil)) as $from |
[
# Cloud Scheduler attempts from the log-based counter mw_scheduler_attempts_<env>,
# ALIGN_SUM per 300 s bucket and per label series. An attempt failed when its
# status label is non-empty and not OK, or its http_status label is
# not 2xx. Bucket with any failed attempt 0, only successful attempts 1. A bucket's
# state holds 120 s past its end (the job's expected interval plus grace), so a job
# that runs hourly or daily keeps its last attempt's state until the next expected run;
# after that, and before the first attempt, the row is null (an empty gap), never a
# healthy value.
def stamp: sub("[.][0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601;
if .error then error("Monitoring query failed")
elif .nextPageToken then error("Scheduler attempt response truncated; shorten the time range")
else
  [.timeSeries[]? |
    ((.metric.labels.status // "") as $s | $s != "" and $s != "OK") as $bad_status |
    ((.metric.labels.http_status // "") as $h | $h != "" and ($h | startswith("2") | not)) as $bad_http |
    ($bad_status or $bad_http) as $failed |
    .points[]? |
    {t: (try (.interval.endTime | stamp) catch null),
     n: (try ((.value.int64Value // .value.doubleValue // 0) | tonumber) catch 0),
     failed: $failed}] |
  map(select(.t != null and .n > 0)) |
  group_by(.t) | map({t: .[0].t, v: (if any(.[]; .failed) then 0 else 1 end)}) as $b |
  [range(0; $b | length) as $i | $b[$i] as $r |
    {time: ($r.t - 300 | todateiso8601), value: $r.v},
    (if $i + 1 < ($b | length) then
       (if $b[$i + 1].t - 300 <= $r.t + 120 then empty else {time: ($r.t + 120 | todateiso8601), value: null} end)
     elif $r.t + 120 < now then {time: ($r.t + 120 | todateiso8601), value: null}
     else empty end)] |
  .[]
end

# {key, label, scale?, state_key?}: scale multiplies (epoch seconds to ms); state_key names a state field
# whose 0 (failed) turns the value into -1 and whose 2 (overdue) into -2, so the panel maps them to

# report) rather than an unqualified age. Missing, stale, future, negative or non-integer samples are
# null, never zero. Provider errors and truncation fail visibly.

def number: (try (.v | tonumber) catch null) as $n | if $n != null and $n >= 0 and ($n | floor) == $n then $n else null end;
if .error then error("Monitoring query failed")
elif .nextPageToken then error("Collector response truncated; shorten the time range")
else

  [[{"key":"pending","label":"Pending"},{"key":"oldest_pending_seconds","label":"Oldest pending"},{"key":"delivered_24h","label":"Sent · 24 h"},{"key":"failed_24h","label":"Failed · 24 h"}][] as $f |

             elif $f.state_key == null then $v * ($f.scale // 1)

               if $code == null then null elif $code == 0 then -1 elif $code == 2 then -2 else $v * ($f.scale // 1) end
             end)}] |
  from_entries
end
) end

panels.description: Debian collector GET /healthz of mw-receipt-recognition (paused when disabled); callers are the DEV and PROD command services. Detail on Agent & Receipts.

targets.root_selector:
# State timeline row: every sample in the range as a state code (0 Down, 1 OK,
# 2 Degraded, 3 Paused, 4 Unknown). Booleans map true 1, false 0. Samples of one
# collector run share a timestamp; the worst member wins (0, 4, 2, 3, then 1) and
# a run missing any of the 1 members is Unknown. A gap longer than
# the freshness bound ends in null at (sample + bound), so no state stretches across
# missing telemetry; a newest sample older than the bound also ends in null at
# (sample + bound), with a second null at now so Unknown reaches the right edge.
# Provider errors and truncation fail visibly.
def stamp: sub("[.][0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601;
def code: if type == "boolean" then (if . then 1 else 0 end)
  else (try tonumber catch null) | if . != null and IN(0, 1, 2, 3, 4) then . else 4 end end;
def worst: if any(.[]; . == 0) then 0 elif any(.[]; . == 4) then 4 elif any(.[]; . == 2) then 2
  elif any(.[]; . == 3) then 3 else 1 end;
if .error then error("Monitoring query failed")
elif .nextPageToken then error("Monitoring response truncated; shorten the time range")
else
  [.timeSeries[]? | .points[]? |
    {t: (try (.interval.endTime | stamp) catch null),
     v: (.value | if has("boolValue") then .boolValue else (.int64Value // .doubleValue) end)}] |
  map(select(.t != null and .t <= now + 120)) |
  group_by(.t) | map({t: .[0].t, n: length, v: ([.[].v | code] | worst)}) as $runs |
  [range(0; $runs | length) as $i | $runs[$i] as $r |
    {time: ($r.t | todateiso8601), value: (if $r.n == 1 then $r.v else 4 end)},
    (if $i + 1 < ($runs | length) and $runs[$i + 1].t - $r.t > 360
     then {time: ($r.t + 360 | todateiso8601), value: null} else empty end)] +
  (if ($runs | length) == 0 then [{time: (now | floor | todateiso8601), value: null}]
   elif now - ($runs | last | .t) > 360
   then [{time: ($runs | last | .t + 360 | todateiso8601), value: null}, {time: (now | floor | todateiso8601), value: null}]
   else [] end) |
  .[]
end
